cohort: The study included 70 insulin-treated gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) patients and 70 healthy control patients from a tertiary referral center.
finding: The Amniotic Fluid/Umbilical Cerebral Ratio (AUCR) and single deepest vertical pocket (SDVP) were significantly higher in GDM patients and in GDM patients with composite adverse perinatal outcomes, with AUCR being identified as a promising predictor for these outcomes.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken during pregnancy between December 2023 to April 2024.
